name: typesafe-tools
description: Bounded Jev evidence evaluation and default capability routing for eligible tasks.

interface.shortDescription: Route eligible tasks with Jev judgments.
interface.longDescription: Jev ranks available skills and tools by default for eligible public or synthetic tasks with a material capability choice. Typed research evaluations remain separately gated. Codex retains final tool and action decisions.
interface.defaultPrompt: Check TypeSafe readiness and route an eligible public or synthetic task among available capabilities.
